subject: armadillo

I need each band's geometry to scale with the cross-sectional radius at its z-position along the ellipsoid, since the shell narrows toward the ends. Computing per-band torus dimensions...

For the shoulder and pelvic shields, I'm adding small hexagonal dots scattered across the surface, computing each dot's direction from the ellipsoid's normal at that point so they sit flush against the curved shell.

Adding a shell-colored head shield ellipsoid plus the snout shape at the head joint, then designing tiny eyes with oversized pale ears typical of an armadillo. Now I'm working out the four stubby legs as cylindrical joint chains running from the body bottom down to small feet near the floor.
